<thought>Only sulfur shows a characteristic M+2 peak (~4 % of the base peak), matching its natural 34S abundance. No chlorine‑like (≈33 % M+2) or bromine‑like (≈100 % M+2) patterns are present, and other elements lack distinctive patterns here. Therefore, sulfur is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
